method: Official tottus.com.pe page 'Tiendas y Horarios' (/tottus-pe/content/horario-tiendas-all, Next.js): the store list is a CMS rich-text block inside __NEXT_DATA__ (props.pageProps.page.containers[20]) with one caption per store (name, address, hours) and a region filter; 56 stores, no coordinates. The page's JS chunks could not be fetched (bot protection) and no store-locator API with coordinates was found, so lat/lng are null for all Tottus stores (later geocoding needed). Added 2 stores from press (secondary=true): Tottus Izaguirre (opened Dec 2025, also mentioned in the official 2025 sustainability report) and Tottus Iquitos (opened Aug 2023; the official page has no Loreto filter). Official count: Tottus Balance de Sostenibilidad 2025 (PDF dated 2026-07-06) says 91 stores in Peru = 59 Tottus + 32 Precio Uno at end-2025; press (peru-retail Dec 2025 / May 2026) says 58 Tottus. We have 58 - possibly missing Tottus Tarapoto: a 2023 peru-retail note mentions a Tottus hypermarket in Tarapoto, but the official Precio Uno site lists a Precio Uno at the same street (Jr. Jiménez Pimentel 1043, Tarapoto), so it was not added here. Districts filled only where the official address names them; blank otherwise.
